couplets.en: Someone came close at daybreak and put me to the test.

lines: Meri daastaan ko zara sa badal kar
couplets.en: My story was altered a little.
At daybreak, it was told back to me.

lines: Jo kehta tha kal shab sambhalna sambhalna
couplets.en: Last night he kept telling me to watch my step.

lines: Jo kehta tha kal shab sambhalna sambhalna
couplets.en: The one who told me to watch my step last night was the one who stumbled at dawn.
It was he who stumbled at dawn.

lines: Kati raat saari meri mai-kade mein
couplets.en: I spent the whole night in the tavern.

lines: Kati raat saari meri mai-kade mein
couplets.en: The whole night passed for me in the tavern.

lines: Kati raat saari meri mai-kade mein
couplets.en: I spent the whole night in the tavern, and at dawn I remembered God.
At daybreak, I was put to the test.
